stories.title: Don't Wait on the Flu Vaccine — Why October Is the Deadline for Kids Under 8

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Kids (6 mo–8 yrs) who need the flu vaccine for the first time need 2 doses, 4 weeks apart — start now to be protected before flu season peaks.

9+ year-olds and kids who got 2 doses last year need just 1 dose.

#COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

facebook.image_caption: 💉 October deadline for two-dose flu vaccines — kids 6 months–8 years who need 2 doses should start now to be protected before flu season peaks.

article.headline: October Is the Month to Act on Flu Vaccines for Young Kids

stories.title: CPSC Warns: Stop Using Mbabyjon Crib Bumpers — Seller Refused to Recall

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
CPSC warning: stop using Mbabyjon padded crib bumpers — suffocation risk, seller refused recall, no refund offered.

Dispose now. Don't resell or give away.

Safe sleep: firm flat surface + fitted sheet only.

#COSParenting #COSKids #ColoradoSprings #PikesPeakParenting
